editorial:
Imagine you are strolling along a sunny beach with your partner when you spot a mysterious woman washed up on the sand. That is exactly how things kick off for Christian, and it quickly turns from a rescue mission into a wild ride. Once he sees this woman again at a fancy yacht party, he gets sucked into a world of secret affairs and dangerous lies. The vibe is very 70s, filled with glamorous locations and a feeling that someone is always watching from the shadows. You will feel like you are stepping into a glossy magazine that slowly turns into a nightmare.

What really works here is how the mystery keeps you guessing about who is actually the villain. The acting is solid for this style of film, and the twists keep the energy high even when the plot gets a bit messy. If you love old-school thrillers with plenty of suspense, you should definitely check this one out. It looks great if you can find the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection, but renting it on Apple TV is a quick way to see if you like the style. Just be ready for some weird turns!
endingExplained: You find out that the mysterious woman was part of a complex plot to steal money and cover up crimes. After a series of deaths, it turns out the people Christian trusted were actually manipulating him. The movie ends with a final confrontation where the truth comes out about the murders. The killer is finally revealed and stopped, though not before leaving a trail of bodies behind in a shocking twist.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 70s Italian thrillers and twisty murder mysteries.
